market_story: Winter Storm Heather (Jan-14-17-2024): MISO North/Central gas units burned gas bought at the Chicago Citygate, where the Friday Jan-12 next-day print hit $25.82/MMBtu (+$12.74 over Henry Hub) and priced the whole MLK-weekend delivery package -- so the marginal CC/CT running Jan-15/16 carried ~$8-13/MMBtu delivered fuel and set $50-100 LMPs across the region. The overlay reads exactly that measured daily citygate shape (flow-date placed, mean-preserving within month) into the Chicago-hub zones' offers; no unit is forced, no floor is added -- the winter tail forms in-merit from the real delivered-fuel cost, which the national HH daily shape and the flat monthly Chicago basis both structurally miss.
